name: Cavern of Mists
summary: Geysers veil the way into the Wailing Caverns from the Cavern of Mists.

sections.title: The Threshold of the Nightmare
sections.body: You cross the Cavern of Mists on the way to the Wailing Caverns' deeper heart. Geysers burst through the floor and feed a deep pool at the center. Warm vapor cloaks the ledges and water, where raptors, serpents, oozes, and threshadons roam. Trigore the Lasher, a rare hydra, prowls here too. Such creatures mark the unnatural growth deeper below.

faq.q: Where is the Cavern of Mists?
faq.answer: Cavern of Mists forms the outer caves of the Wailing Caverns, southwest of the Crossroads in the Barrens. You cross this chamber to reach the portal into the deeper caves.

faq.q: Why is it called the Cavern of Mists?
faq.answer: Geysers burst through the stone floor, feeding the central pool and filling the cavern with humid fog.
Raptors, oozes, wind serpents, snakes, toads, and threshadons live around the pool. The rare hydra Trigore the Lasher is sometimes seen there too.
Trigore the Lasher is a dangerous rare hydra, sometimes found swimming with the threshadons in the central pool.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, you see the twisted wildlife in these heavy vapors as a warning: Naralex's communion with the Emerald Dream has gone badly astray.
As a member of the Horde, you know that clearing predatory beasts from these mists helps secure the trade routes and outposts around the Crossroads.
